# Shashika Fernando

> Software engineer in Colombo, Sri Lanka, working across distributed systems, security and applied AI, from research prototypes to products in production.

This site has two views of the same content:

- [Interactive dial](/): an intro, then six sections (Welcome, About, Education, Projects, Experience, Contact) navigated by a watch-dial instrument.
- [Gallery](/gallery): every system as an image collage.
- [Profile](/profile): a quick-read profile with a feed of every project, filterable by websites, mobile apps, backend, AI, research and games.

## Selected work

- TieHere: proximity app for professionals to meet in person. Flutter, Go API gateway and modular monolith over gRPC, PostgreSQL on Supabase, Google Cloud Run. https://tiehere.com
- Enterprise Ticket Management System: Next.js 16 ticketing platform with Postgres row-level security, mandatory TOTP for admins, 435 unit tests and 19 end-to-end specs.
- Modern Womenswear Storefront: Next.js storefront with a scroll-scrubbed canvas film and statically generated product pages.
- AshiruLabs website: studio site with a real-time Three.js scene driven by scroll. https://ashirulabs.com
- Offline-First Field Sales App: Flutter app with an ASP.NET Core API over an existing SQL Server back office.
- Healthy Meal Pre-Ordering App: Flutter app on a NestJS modular-monolith backend.
- AI Data Analyst for a bakery business: plain-English questions answered by SQL over read-only views, with a deterministic production planner.
- VoltNexus: event-driven EV-charging microservices (Spring Cloud Gateway, RabbitMQ, transactional outbox).
- Research: chaotic-map password pre-hashing before Argon2id; 3D U-Net liver tumour segmentation.

## Writing

- [Five services to two: running TieHere for about $0 a month](/writing/tiehere-five-services-to-two): consolidating Go microservices into a gateway and modular monolith on Cloud Run, with production latency, load-test and cost figures.
